headline: Handmade with Love by Lisa
body: Every piece at Lisa Custom Keychains is made to order, right here by Lisa. Gift-ready and fully personalized — no two are ever the same.
notes: Primary brand awareness ad. Use on homepage hero or pinned social post.

headline: The Perfect Little Gift
body: Simple, beautiful, and made by hand. Keep it on your keys, your bag, or give one to someone you love. The easiest gift you'll ever find.
notes: Low price point ad — great for cold audiences and first-time buyers.

headline: Stock Up for Your Next Event
subheadline: Handmade keychains at $2.95 — perfect for party favors & giveaways
body: Birthdays, baby showers, team gifts, church events — Lisa's woven keychains make the most thoughtful handmade favor at a price that works for any budget.
notes: Target: event planners, moms, teachers, church groups.

headline: Carry Something Made Just for You
body: Pick your colors, pick your style. Every keychain is handcrafted to order by Lisa — made exactly the way you want it. No two are the same.
notes: Core mid-tier ad. Emphasize customization over price.

headline: The Gift They'll Actually Keep
body: No more guessing what to get. Pick their colors, choose their charms, and Lisa handcrafts it just for them. Ships gift-ready — zero effort on your end.
notes: Gifting angle — great for Mothers Day, birthdays, Christmas.

headline: Go All Out. Go Epic.
body: More beads, bolder patterns, a design as unique as the person wearing it. Our Epic Custom keychains are made to turn heads. Gift one or keep it for yourself — you deserve it.
notes: Premium tier ad — push quality and uniqueness over affordability.

headline: Rep Your Team, Handmade Style
body: Basketball, soccer, softball, football — your sport, your colors, your keychain. Show your team spirit with a one-of-a-kind piece made by hand, just for you.
notes: Sports angle — targets parents, coaches, team moms. Pair with sports mockup images.

headline: Dangle in Style
body: Statement earrings made by hand, one pair at a time. Pick your charms, choose your colors, and wear something nobody else is wearing.
notes: Core earring ad — lead with visual of the finished earrings.

headline: Wear Your Heart
body: A little love, handcrafted just for you. Sweet, bold, and completely one-of-a-kind. Our heart earrings make the perfect gift for someone special — or a treat for yourself.
notes: Valentine's Day, Galentines, Mothers Day seasonal push.

headline: Boho Soul. Lisa's Hands.
body: Artisan boho earrings you won't find anywhere else. Woven with intention, worn with confidence. Each pair takes hours to create — because some things are worth the time.
notes: Target boho/festival fashion audience on Instagram Reels.

headline: Your Look. Your Charms.
body: No template. No mass production. You tell Lisa what you want and she makes it happen — every bead, every charm chosen by you. Wear something that's actually yours.
notes: Premium earring tier. Lean into customization story.

headline: Match the Moment
body: Why pick just one? Get the earrings and the keychain to match. A coordinated set that tells your story — handcrafted by Lisa and shipped together.
notes: Great upsell ad — target existing keychain buyers.

headline: Find Us at the Summer Craft Market
subheadline: Saturday, June 21 — Come meet Lisa in person!
body: Watch Lisa make your custom piece right in front of you. Shop the full collection, pick your colors on the spot, and take it home same day. Come find us at the Summer Craft Market!
notes: Event promotion for Summer Craft Market June 21. Use bright summer palette.

headline: Show Your Red, White & Custom
subheadline: Handmade Fourth of July keychains & earrings
body: Celebrate independence in style. Lisa's custom July 4th designs are here — red, white, blue, and handmade with love. Limited availability, order early!
notes: Seasonal event ad — post 2 weeks before July 4th pop-up event.

headline: Summer's Better Handmade
subheadline: Bright colors, beach vibes — available now
body: Bold summer colors, festival charms, beach-ready accessories. Lisa's handmade summer collection is here and ready to ship. Grab yours before the season ends.
notes: Seasonal awareness ad — run June through August.

headline: Every Piece Tells a Story
subheadline: Handmade by Lisa, one at a time
body: Lisa doesn't use machines or factories. Every keychain, every earring is made by hand — her hands — with real care for every customer. When you order from Lisa, you're not just buying an accessory. You're supporting a maker.
notes: Brand story / trust-builder ad. Great for retargeting warm audiences.

headline: A Gift as Thoughtful as They Are
body: Show your teacher how much they mean with a one-of-a-kind handmade keychain. Pick their favorite colors, add a charm, and give something truly personal. Ships fast.
notes: Seasonal — Teacher Appreciation Week (May) and end of school year.

headline: For the Best Friend Who Has Everything
body: Get one for you, one for her. Pick matching colors or go complementary — either way, it's a handmade moment she'll remember every time she reaches for her keys.
notes: Friendship/gifting angle — great for Galentine's Day and back to school.
